name: Tetrahedron Volumetric Divergence (TVD) Predictor
definition: A metric to approximate the volumetric divergence between an extracted isosurface mesh (from Marching Cubes) and the ideal trilinear interpolation isosurface within a cube. It models the volume between the mesh and the ideal surface using tetrahedra.
summary: The TVD Predictor is a fast, closed-form metric approximating isosurface error by modeling volume between planar meshes and ideal surfaces using tetrahedra, avoiding the recursive subdivision required by Volumetric Divergence Metric.
